profile.headline: Software Engineer at TwinSpires.com - A Churchill Downs Company

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: Assisting with the development of a supply chain single-page application for Feeding America. Helped develop an algorithm for apportioning food donations into truckloads with maximal weight and item quantity. Working mainly on the front-end with functionality and view design.

positions.title: Package Handler
positions.description: Responsible for packing semi-trucks, and sorting packages during peak season.

positions.title: Seasonal Installation Assistant
positions.description: Aided in the installation of commercial Christmas decorations around Louisville.

positions.title: Research Adjunct
positions.description: Participated in a summer program at IDA/CCR-P.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Graded for the department of Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, and Statistics.

positions.title: Applied Research Mathematician
positions.description: Participated in the Cryptanalysis & Exploitation Services Summer Program (CESSP). Collaborated with another program participant and full-time agency analysts on a classified project concerning the exploitation of foreign communications. Aided in the diagnosis of an advanced cryptographic system.

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description: Tutored Mathematics for groups and individuals in College Algebra, Business Calculus, Pre-Calculus, and Calculus I,II,III. Assisted a variety of students with very different mathematical backgrounds and learning styles on both a group and individual basis. Worked with students to solve problems and encourage development of analytical thinking skills.

honors.title: Honors Thesis
honors.description: Completed the Honors Program at Georgetown College culminating with the joint thesis “An Eigensystem Method for Determining Node Influence in a Coauthor Network” by Kurtis Mann and Eric Mortberg. This work was presented at the annual meeting of the Kentucky MAA in Spring 2014.
